author: IGN
description: Kaiject is a meditative first-person action experience set on the surface and inside the bodies of giant kaiju. Explore their living structures, overcome deadly hazards, and find a way to stop the creatures before they destroy everything in their path. Check out the Kaiject announcement trailer to see exploration, gameplay, and more. Kaiject will be available on PC in 2026.
title: Kaiject - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: Maxell's Remix portable cassette deck does away with some of the most annoying parts of the old-school tape deck experience, namely grinding through AA batteries and catching the headphone cord on things. As far as audio quality, it sounds pretty much how you'd expect from a modern tapedeck, but if you're listening to music on your phone speaker you probably won't even mind.
title: The Maxell Remix Is the Portable Cassette Deck for the Phone Speaker Generation

author: IGN
description: Sony has insisted it has no plans to sell hardware at a “significant” loss, with concern growing over the potential price of the PlayStation 6 amid the ongoing RAM shortage. Plus, it has suggested its next-gen console could work like the Nintendo Switch by enabling quote “a seamless experience that can be enjoyed naturally beyond the living room.” Daemon has all that and more in your Daily Fix!
title: Sony Says It Won't Sell Hardware at a 'Significant' Loss - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Dichotomy Beta Test Trailer for Silver Palace, an upcoming open-world fantasy action RPG developed by Elementa. Players will embody a detective seeking answers to the depths of Silvernia's underworld. Explore multiple locales, make use of powerful abilities, and seek the truth at all costs. Silver Palace is coming soon to Consoles, Mobile, and PC with the Dichotomy Beta Test being available now until July 16 on PC.

#SilverPalace #Gaming #IGN
title: Silver Palace - Official Dichotomy Beta Test Trailer

#IGN #Gaming

author: IGN
description:
Join co-founder and executive producer Jean-François Boivin for a deep dive into the world of 1666: Amsterdam in this latest video for the upcoming third-person action-adventure game. Learn about the history and world of the Zaindaris, and meet Noa: heir to the Zaindaris line and a Collector in her beginning. 1666: Amsterdam will be available on PC. The prologue is available to play now on Steam and Epic Games Store.

Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.

#ign #gaming
title: 1666: Amsterdam - Official Gameplay Feature Video

author: IGN
description:
Meet Lux and Samira in this latest 2XKO trailer for the free-to-play fighting game from developer Riot Games (the studio behind Valorant and League of Legends). The new trailer gives us a peek at the new champions in action ahead of their arrival in 2XKO later in 2026. In 2XKO, fight solo or with a friend in explosive 2v2 showdowns, mastering a range of powerful champion abilities and unique tag mechanics to take down the enemy duo. 

2XKO is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.

#2XKO #Gaming #IGN

author: IGN
description:
Parenthood is a game-changer. Watch the trailer for The Angry Birds Movie 3, an upcoming animated film starring Jason Sudeikis, Josh Gad, Emma Myers, Rachel Bloom, Walker Scobell, Danny McBride, Marcello Hernández, Tim Robinson, Anna Cathcart, Maitreyi Ramakrishnan, Nikki Glaser, MrBeast, Salish Matter, Psalm West, Sam Richardson, James Austin Johnson with Lily James and Keke Palmer.

This holiday season, one angry bird will face his greatest challenge yet, surviving fatherhood… while saving the world!

Executive producers of The Angry Birds Movie 3 are Louis Koo, Toru Nakahara, Ben Mattes, Hanna Valkeapää-Nokkala, Crosby Clyse, Chris Pflug, Simon Hedges, Christopher Milburn, Jamey Heath, Paul Kang, Geneva Wasserman, and Cathy Boxall. The Angry Birds Movie 3 is produced by John Cohen, Dan Chuba, Carla Connor, and Namit Malhotra. The screenplay is by Thurop Van Orman.

The Angry Birds Movie 3, directed by John Rice, opens in theaters on December 23, 2026.

#TheAngryBirdsMovie3 #AngryBi
title: The Angry Birds Movie 3 - Official Trailer (2026) Jason Sudeikis, Josh Gad, Emma Myers, Rachel Bloom

author: IGN
description:
Robert Eggers returns to helm this adaptation of the Wolfman myth, promising to be the most visceral and haunting experience Eggers has done so far! 

In the Medieval English countryside, a mysterious and terrible creature stalks the night, preying on any who come across its path. 

Werewulf see's Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Willem Dafoe, and Lily-Rose Depp returning from their work together on Eggers last movie; Nosferatu, for an all new terrifying take on the classic mythos. 

Werewulf comes to cinemas on December 25th 2026!
title: Werewulf - Official Trailer (2026) Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Willem Dafoe, Lily-Rose Depp

author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the all new trailer for Team Samurai Outriders in Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls! 

Lead by Robbie Reyes Ghost Rider, Team Samurai Outriders brings in Blade, Loki and Deadpool with the Asgard stage. Loki is a tricky character laying down traps to bait opponents into making mistakes, Blade is a rushdown master utilising the Muramasa blade. Deadpool brings his signature third wall breaking referential style to his gameplay, taking attacks from other famous fighting games. 

Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls, launches on August 6, 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls - Official Samurai Outriders Trailer
